text: Soren Lindqvist and Dr. Amara Osei finally bring the finished study to Helena Vasquez and Meridian's leadership -- the real numbers, no spin.
On ibm_brisbane, the optimal portfolio stopped standing out, and some runs didn't even respect the exactly-four-assets rule.
Dr. Osei traced it to a real cause: validating only on an ideal simulator, then jumping straight to real hardware with nothing in between.
Readout error mitigation and zero-noise extrapolation genuinely helped -- but didn't fully close the gap to the ideal simulator.
The honest bottom line: classical still wins here today, and that's exactly the answer Helena asked for back in video one.
